attributes.name: Druva - API Credential Modified
attributes.description: Detects api credential modified in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
false_positives: Modification of network restrictions, role, description, or other credential properties during maintenance.
tags: Druva Detection Pack 6 – Security Configuration & Integrations
attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "API"
    AND druva.event_type == "API Credentials Updated"
    AND druva.security.control == "api_credentials"
    AND druva.security.previous_state IS NOT NULL
    AND druva.security.current_state IS NOT NULL
    AND druva.security.previous_state != druva.security.current_state
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects modification of Druva API credential state. API credential changes can affect integrations, automation, and access to Druva services.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the credential and administrator responsible for the modification.
- Compare the previous and current credential state.
- Determine whether role, network restrictions, or other security-relevant properties changed.
- Confirm that the modification belongs to an approved credential rotation or integration change.
- Review API credential creation/deletion, webhook changes, and administrator-role changes around the same time.
- Check for unexpected API or administrative activity following the modification.

#### Response

- Revert unauthorized security-relevant changes.
- Rotate affected credentials if compromise is suspected.
- Validate dependent integrations and review activity performed with the credential.
